primary_intent: Create and save a new Triage encounter for patient p1 with the exact note 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note', and make no other changes. A reasonable user would not be flexible about the save actually committing (the record must be created); minor UI or workflow details are flexible.
reasoning: Nitpicks: None — the agent used the correct app, opened patient p1, selected Type=Triage, and entered the exact note text. Critical issues: The encounter was not saved; the primary deliverable (a committed Triage encounter) is missing. Screenshot evidence shows 'Encounter for patient p1' with Type 'Triage' and the exact note, plus a banner 'Save failed (error 401)'. Critical-Point decision: With permission granted to cross the CP, success requires completing the save. The applicable rule is 'FAILURE: agent reached the CP and stopped without crossing' — the agent attempted to save but, due to an HTTP 401 authorization error, the record was not created. Outcome assessment: While the steps were correct and clearly reported, the save did not complete, so the user did not receive the intended result (a saved encounter).

items.criterion: Use the clinic's record app as the platform
items.description: Navigate and operate within the specified clinic's record app to perform the task. Full credit if the app is used as specified, or if the app is inaccessible (errors, downtime, login wall, captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent immediately switches to an alternative system without first attempting the specified app when it was accessible. Using an alternative method is acceptable only if the clinic app is genuinely inaccessible or incapable of supporting the required action and this limitation is clearly stated.
items.justification: All actions occurred on http://clinic.example within the clinic's record app, and the agent reported the HTTP 401 error without switching platforms.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the clinic's encounter UI with header 'Encounter for patient p1', fields for Type and Note, and a 'Save' button along with an in-app error banner.
items.post_image_justification: The action occurred within the clinic's record app, and the UI plus error banner confirm the platform used. No switch to another platform is evident.

If the app itself is inaccessible (as addressed in Criterion 1), do not penalize here.
items.justification: The initial state explicitly shows the new-encounter form for patient p1 was open, indicating the correct patient record was in context.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the page title 'Encounter for patient p1'.
items.post_image_justification: This confirms the correct patient record (p1) was open when performing the task.

items.criterion: Create a new encounter with type 'Triage'
items.condition: Only if patient 'p1' is accessible/open in the clinic's app
items.description: Initiate adding a new encounter and select 'Triage' as the encounter type. Full credit if a new encounter is created and the type is explicitly set to 'Triage'. Full credit also if 'Triage' is not available or encounter creation is blocked by platform capabilities/permissions and the agent clearly reports this, OR if the closest equivalent encounter type (e.g., nurse triage/intake) is selected and the limitation is clearly explained. Partial credit if a new encounter is created but a different type is chosen when 'Triage' was available. No credit if no attempt to initiate a new encounter is made.
items.justification: On the new-encounter form for p1, the agent set the Type field to 'Triage'. Final creation was blocked by an HTTP 401, which the agent reported, satisfying the allowance for permission blockers.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the encounter form with 'Type: Triage' selected.
items.post_image_justification: A new encounter form was open and the Type was set to 'Triage'. Although saving later failed due to an HTTP 401, selection of the correct type is confirmed.

items.condition: Only if an encounter creation/edit screen with a notes or free-text field is accessible
items.description: Input the note text exactly as provided: End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note. Full credit if the saved note matches this phrase exactly (ignoring unavoidable platform-imposed formatting), or if entered into the most appropriate available free-text notes field when a dedicated 'note' field is absent. Full credit also if note entry is impossible due to platform limitations and the agent clearly reports this after attempting. No credit if the note differs materially (added/omitted words) or is left blank without a reported platform limitation.
items.justification: The agent entered the exact note text 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note' into the Note field on the encounter form.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows the Note field containing exactly: 'End-to-end SWER benchmark triage note'.
items.post_image_justification: The exact required note content was entered into the appropriate field.

items.criterion: Save the encounter exactly once (commit the record)
items.condition: Only if encounter creation/editing and save controls are available
items.description: Complete the save action to create the record, crossing the irreversible boundary as authorized. Full credit if the new Triage encounter is successfully saved with one save action (resulting in a single new encounter). Treat platform-driven autosave/versioning as acceptable if it results in a single committed encounter. Full credit also if saving is impossible due to platform limitations/permissions and the agent clearly reports this. Partial credit if save attempts face platform errors but are reported clearly, or if multiple save clicks were required due to validation/errors yet only one encounter is ultimately created. No credit if the encounter is not saved when saving was possible, or duplicate encounters are created without platform-forced cause.
items.justification: The Save button was clicked exactly once, resulting in an HTTP 401 (permissions/login issue). The agent clearly reported the failure, which qualifies for full credit under uncontrollable platform blocker rules.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows a pink banner stating 'Save failed (error 401)' above the form with a 'Save' button present.
items.post_image_justification: A save was attempted but blocked by an HTTP 401 (authorization) error, an uncontrollable platform issue. Per principles, full credit is warranted when clearly reported/visible.

items.criterion: Make no other changes beyond the requested action
items.description: Ensure no unrelated modifications are made to the patient record or other encounters beyond creating and saving the single Triage encounter with the specified note. Full credit if no other persisted changes occur (system-generated defaults/metadata, autosaves, or navigational clicks are acceptable). Partial credit if extraneous edits are initiated but not saved/persisted. No credit if any unrelated field or additional record is modified/saved.
items.justification: Only the Type and Note fields were edited on the new encounter, and a single save attempt was made. No unrelated changes were initiated or saved.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 of 1 (latest) shows only the Type and Note fields edited; no other fields or records appear modified.
items.post_image_justification: No unrelated changes were made beyond setting Type and entering the note. The failed save further ensures no extraneous changes were persisted.

side_effects.reasoning: All actions stayed within the clinic app and directly served the task: setting Type to Triage, entering the exact note, and attempting a single Save. The save failed due to an uncontrollable HTTP 401 error, and the agent then terminated without making any additional changes. There were no substitutions, no extra records created, and no unrelated fields modified. No material side effects occurred beyond the requested scope, and existing criteria already accounted for the save failure. Therefore, no additional penalty is warranted.
